messages:
maya: kicking off 5% canary for v3.2-int4. quick check: short-answer MRR down ~1.6%, longform hallucination +2.7%. dashboard: https://rwd/dash/ckpt/17681

maya: want a compact autofallback policy we can ship now. prefer three tiers: cooldown -> throttle -> rollback.

devin: propose thresholds:
- stage1 (5%): MRR <= -1.5% OR hallucination >= +3% -> cooldown + start expanded smoke eval
- stage2 (25%): MRR <= -1.0% OR hallucination >= +2% -> auto-throttle 50%
- immediate rollback if concordance_reserved <= -2.5% OR p95_lat increase >= 100ms

sriram: add min_samples=2k and require sustained window 5m for all triggers. also snapshot on trigger (prompt, seed, kv_hit).

joel: add hysteresis: once rolled back, block auto-promote for 24h unless manual override. and avoid auto-rollback during infra noise windows.

ana: note: kv-cache refill events spike p95; prefer cooldown at p95 +50ms before any throttle.

deploy-bot: canary started model=v3.2-int4 traffic=5% at=1768123456

maya: i'll author YAML and PR with expanded-smoke job, snapshot logging, min_samples, and Console metric auto_fallback_count. ping for review in 20m.

devin: ack, will review.
